name: axonsynth-inference
summary: Segments axons in a 3D light-sheet microscopy volume with the AxonSynth three_class_v2 MONAI 3D U-Net, after optional resampling to isotropic voxels, and outputs a binary axon mask and probability map.
description: Optionally resamples an anisotropic LSM NIfTI to isotropic model space (default 0.8 micron, axis order 2,0,1), then runs sliding-window inference with the bundled three_class_v2 checkpoint (background, axon shell, axon interior) and collapses shell and interior into a thresholded binary foreground. Use it for automated axon segmentation of LSM data. It runs on GPU when available and falls back to CPU unless require_cuda is set.

inputs.description: Raw or already-prepared 3D LSM microscopy volume (NIfTI).

outputs.description: Predicted binary axon segmentation (AxonSynth three_class_v2, shell+interior collapsed to foreground) as parc.nii.gz, with label.json, plus the foreground probability map and inference metadata as extra files.

parameters.description: Skip the anisotropic-to-isotropic resample step; use only when input_volume is already isotropic at model spacing (0.8um by default).
Target isotropic voxel size in microns for the prepare step. Ignored if skip_prepare is true.
Comma-separated permutation of 0,1,2 mapping model axes to source axes for the prepare step. Ignored if skip_prepare is true.
Treat source NIfTI header zoom values as microns when the header does not declare micron units. Ignored if skip_prepare is true.
Isotropic sliding-window ROI size used during inference.
Foreground probability threshold applied to produce the binary segmentation.
Device used to stitch sliding-window logits: 'model' (default, same device as the model) or 'cpu' (for volumes that exceed GPU memory when stitched).
'binary_focused' (default) writes only the collapsed foreground probability/mask; 'full' additionally writes the three-class argmax, shell, and interior masks.
Fail instead of silently falling back to CPU when no GPU is available on the compute resource.
Comma-separated LABEL=VALUE pairs for extra binary masks at additional probability thresholds, e.g. '0p94=0.94'. Empty means none.

failure_modes.cause: Inference did not write the segmentation output.
failure_modes.fix: Check the log for errors in the prepare or inference step (e.g. wrong axis_order or missing GPU with require_cuda).
